text: ボスが　シルフ　カンパニーで　ぬすんで　きた　マシンの　ことか！

structure.jp: ボスが　シルフ　カンパニーで　ぬすんで　きた
structure.en: that the boss stole at Silph Co. and brought back

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says someone did it and then came back. ぬすんで　きた = 'stole it and came back with it'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ボスが　シルフ　カンパニーで　ぬすんで　きた　マシン
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. ボスが　シルフ　カンパニーで　ぬすんで　きた　マシン = 'the machine the boss stole at Silph Co.'.

patterns.name: 〜のことか
patterns.explanation: のことか after a thing shows you have just worked out what the other person is talking about. マシンの　ことか = 'oh, you mean the machine'.
